summary: Frontend E2E testing of Arshia birthday website (iter 3, big upgrade). Full intro flow + all sections tested. 15/16 critical checks pass. New 12 Reasons popup, Memory Jar stacking, Cloud Wheel result, Cake shift+message, Grand Finale gift-box, single hidden audio (no music player UI), Aap compliment (verified via data), and Secret Letter placement all work correctly. Section order matches spec exactly. Only issue: clicking backdrop of Reasons popup at extreme corner (50,50) didn't dismiss popup in the automated test — likely selector/timing flake but worth main agent verification.

ui_bugs.issue: In automated test, clicking backdrop at (50,50) did not close popup. Backdrop is z-[85] fixed inset-0 with onClick={setActive(null)} and inner content stops propagation. May be flaky test, but recommend manual verify that outside-click dismiss works. The wheel-close/outside-close for other modals worked fine.

action_items: (Optional) Manually verify Reasons popup can be dismissed by clicking outside the centered card (backdrop click).
(Optional cleanup) /app/frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.jsx file still exists in repo but is not imported anywhere. Can be deleted since spec requires no music-player UI.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js correctly renders a single hidden <audio> element and no MusicPlayer component — matches requirement.
Intro.jsx calls onMusicStart exactly once inside submit() before setStage('name') — music starts only on correct password.

Section order in App.js JSX matches the required spec exactly (Hero → Gallery → Story → Videos → Reasons → MemoryJar → Letters → Wheel → Cake → Compliments → BestFriendMeter → SecretLetter → Finale). Verified by DOM vertical positions.
Reasons.jsx cards show trait+emoji only on face (no compliment text), popup uses Typewriter — matches spec.
Finale.jsx uses gift-box testid with SVG lid animation and reveals FINALE_MESSAGE containing 'Thank you for being the most wonderful mitra of my life' — matches spec.
Outro/'Thank You For Visiting' component has been removed — confirmed via body text and no outro-section testid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React birthday site. Password 01012000. Timing after unlock: 1.9s football-kick + ~7s name-reveal. Use domcontentloaded (never networkidle — looping bg videos+audio keep network busy). All expected data-testids exist. Reasons popup outside-click dismiss should be manually re-verified; all other modals close correctly (letters via close-letter, wheel via wheel-close, gallery via gallery-close).
